aiOverview.content: For the NYT Strands puzzle on March 21 (#748), the theme is "Spring fever," featuring words related to spirals and twists, with TWISTANDTURN as the spangram. The theme words are COIL, CURLICUE, CORKSCREW, GYRE, SPIRAL, and HELIX. March 21, 2026 (#748) - Spring Fever Spangram: TWISTANDTURN Answers: COIL CURLICUE CORKSCREW GYRE SPIRAL HELIX March 20, 2026 (#747) - Off the hook Spangram: SPOKEN Answers: POST MULE ROBES RUSE CONES SCONE MATES SPOTS March 19, 2026 (#746) - Potluck Spangram: POTLUCK Answers: DESSERT CASSEROLE VEGGIES BEVERAGE APPETIZERS How to get hints:Find any words of four letters or more to fill the hint meter. Every three words found, the game reveals a theme word.
